caption: Multiple engage now cycles its strike target: once genuinely fighting 2+ adjacent enemy regiments at once (around tick 320-340 here), target_enemy rotates from the first to the second so both take casualties -- the first enemy drops 20 to 13 soldiers, then holds there once the cycle moves on; the second holds at 24 untouched, then drops to 21 -- instead of the second sitting untouched forever.
